name: Syrup and the Ultimate Sweet
source:
SYRUP AND THE ULTIMATE SWEET is a visual novel made for YuriJam 2015! It's about a candy alchemist, Syrup, who one day finds a candy golem in her basement workshop. Where did she come from?? Who the heck made her????? GO FIND OUT!!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946740/Syrup_and_the_Ultimate_Sweet/]Steam[/url]]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946750/Syrup_2_Candy_Alchemy_RPG/]Syrup 2: Candy Alchemy RPG[/url] is the direct sequel to this game.
translation:
《糖浆与终极甜蜜》是为YuriJam 2015制作的视觉小说！这是关于一位糖果炼金术士Syrup的故事，有一天她在她的地下室工作室中发现了一个糖果傀儡。她从哪里来？？到底是谁让她这样的？？？？去了解一下吧！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946740/Syrup_and_the_Ultimate_Sweet/]Steam[/url]]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946750/Syrup_2_Candy_Alchemy_RPG/]Syrup 2: Candy Alchemy RPG[/url] 是这款游戏的直接续作。
